reset_AndroidEnv: reset the AndroidEnv RL environment to start a new episode
step_AndroidEnv: take a step in the AndroidEnv environment with a given action dictionary
close_AndroidEnv: close the AndroidEnv and clean up running processes and threads
load_state_AndroidEnv: load a saved simulator state into the AndroidEnv from a LoadStateRequest
save_state_AndroidEnv: save the current AndroidEnv simulator state to a SaveStateRequest
